text:
The plate holds about 3-4 strips of cooked bacon. Cooked bacon runs roughly 8-10 g per strip and about 4.5 kcal/g, which gives roughly 40 kcal per strip.

The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. The strips are fairly thick and look like they have been cooked, but not to a crisp. I count three to four pieces: one on top, one on the left curving, and two on the right and bottom, so about 4 strips at roughly 10 g each, or 40 g total.

At about 4.7 kcal/g, 40 g comes to about 185 kcal. I'll round that down to 170.
